verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents Skills performing one operation across many items at once. The closest items don't count. The PDF 'merges multiple PDFs' line is a sample description in the spec, not a shipped batch capability. 'Up to 20 Skills for each request' is about loading skills, not acting on items. Piped CLI input, subagents and agent teams are host-platform Claude Code features, not Skills capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
